assertion_results.text: Flags curl -k as disabling TLS verification

assertion_results.evidence: Applied fixes: 'CheckHealth.timeoutSeconds (check 5, Medium): I lowered it from 1200 to 600. aws:executeScript runs for at most 600 seconds.'
